description: I would like create a different and unique way of app for helping the farmers. I would like to invite team members who are really enthusiastic and passionate about this development.
summary:
*Georgos - Smart Farming App*

I developed Georgos, a smart farming app to support farmers with simple, practical digital tools.

The app creates a Digital Farmer Passport and Land Passport for each farmer, with a virtual model of their land using geospatial mapping. It provides live crop prices, nearby market details, best harvesting time, storage recommendations, water availability levels, and farming tools information.

It also includes a farming calendar with daily, weekly, and monthly reminders, a Crop Rotation Simulator for best rotation strategies, multi-language support, and a reward system that motivates farmers when they complete tasks and earn profit.

For farmers without smartphones, Georgos provides SMS and voice call support so no one is left out.

It addresses the challenge of low income, lack of information, and poor planning in farming. It is important because it helps farmers make better decisions, reduce losses, increase profit, and farm with confidence using technology made for them.

details: Georgos - From Soil to Success is a smart farming web app made for any farmer in any location, which works by taking the farmer's location, land size and crop details and then fetching real live satellite data from NASA POWER API for that location, including temperature, rainfall, humidity and sunlight for the last 7 days, and using that data to give simple advice on crop rotation, irrigation, fertilizer and weather alerts; its benefits are that it saves farmers money, time and water, increases crop yield, reduces risk of crop failure, and is free and easy to use, while its intended impact is to help small farmers everywhere farm smarter, protect soil and environment, increase income and show how NASA space technology can solve real farming problems on Earth; the project was developed using Google AI Studio with HTML, CSS / Tailwind CSS, JavaScript / TypeScript and JSON for NASA data, tested on a normal laptop and mobile phone with internet and no special hardware, and it is creative because it uniquely combines Space to Soil by bringing trusted NASA satellite data together with crop advice for any location in one simple design made for real farmers, with the team carefully considering user simplicity, different climates and weather conditions, low cost using only free tools, accuracy by using real NASA data instead of fake data, and long-term sustainability through healthy soil and crop rotation
